description: Defines an enum 'Sensor' representing various sensor types and their properties for a vehicle control system, including categories, units, value ranges, and methods for lookup and processing.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: An enum representing various sensors with properties such as name, category, units, value ranges, color, and methods for sensor management.

methods.name: getSensorsForCategory
methods.description: Returns a collection of sensors belonging to a specified category.

methods.name: processAdvance
methods.description: Adjusts advance values greater than 360 by subtracting 720.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Finds a sensor by name, returning a default if not found.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units of measurement for the sensor.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum value for the sensor.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for the sensor.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the background color associated with the sensor.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value for the sensor.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the field type of the sensor.

methods.name: translateValue
methods.description: Processes and possibly adjusts the sensor value, e.g., for advance sensors.
